verdict.rationale: High availability and automatic failover are clearly documented: the docs and README say CockroachDB survives disk, machine, rack and datacenter failures with no manual intervention, and multi-region survival goals set how many simultaneous failures a database tolerates. The read-replica half is thin, evidenced only by a community remark that Follower Reads exist as an enterprise feature. Missing for 10: first-party docs on adding read replicas or follower reads, a detailed failover-behavior walkthrough (timings, leaseholder transfer), and independent hands-on failover corroboration.
